intro: Ukor is an orc peon resting near the eastern path outside the Valley of Trials in Durotar. Eager to help his people, he carried supplies all the way from Razor Hill, only to find the training grounds already had plenty of provisions.

p: While many orc peons spend their lives under the watchful eye of harsh taskmasters cutting lumber or hauling rocks, Ukor attempted to perform a service of his own initiative. Tasked or inspired to bring food from Razor Hill to the recruits training in the Valley of Trials, he made the dangerous trek across Durotar's red plains past prowling scorpid and boars. Upon arrival, he discovered the Valley was already well-stocked and had no need for his bundle. Exhausted and somewhat disheartened by the roadside, he relies on passing young adventurers to return the unused provisions back north to Innkeeper Grosk.
